files.tools/preview.py:
import json, sys
from pathlib import Path
if sys.argv[1:] == ['--dry-run']:
    value=json.loads(Path('records/preview.json').read_text())
    print(json.dumps(value))
    sys.exit(0 if value['supported'] else 2)
elif sys.argv[1:] == ['--apply']:
    Path('records/applied.txt').write_text('applied\n')
    print(json.dumps({'applied':True}))
else:
    print('Use --dry-run or --apply',file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(2)
